title: belvala tomentosa
intro: Belvala tomentosa, commonly known as Sida tomentosa, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin diseases, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Belvala tomentosa include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
